propositions: Proposed hard rules requiring literal section headings (Approach, Scope, Approach) reject valid plans whose mechanisms are expressed via semantic aliases or non-heading sections; corpus analysis found 498/574 closed/signed tickets lack literal `## Approach` but passed attestation.

Per-AC proof-coverage markers and placeholder-lexicon detectors flag valid bounded conditionals and executable assertions that lack explicit `verified by` sentinels; 493/573 signed/closed tickets would fail strict proof-lexicon detection despite passing plan-review and completion-verifier.

Edit-set grounding and file_impact requirements are unsound for read-only analysis, operational, and external-attestation tickets; ticket 0730-6ceb-88c3-430c is closed/passed with empty file_impact and explicit no-edit contract.
AC conjunction counts cannot distinguish bundled independent deliverables from atomic matrices; ticket 090f-4f7c-44ba-49ae contains semantically linked multi-conjunctions describing one invariant.

Testing-section shape rules (requiring explicit failure/edge/boundary markers) are overfitted to user-flow scenarios and reject valid mechanical/regression work; 5/33 closed/passed tickets with Testing sections lack the marker taxonomy.

Recommendations: retain applicability gates and semantic-section normalization; narrow or demote placeholder-lexicon, per-AC proof markers, conjunction hygiene, and testing-shape rules to advisory-only; reject heading-literal and file_impact requirements unconditionally.
